Commentary.Commentary: A target of 229 to chase down in a World Cup final. India certainly posses the quality, but England do have the bowlers too. It all makes for an entertaining second half. There is rain forecast through the afternoon. We hope, like before in the day, it doesn't happen. Join us in a short while for all the action.

The game was about phases. But the main one was Jhulan Goswami's spell in the middle overs. She came in and broke that all-important Taylor-Sciver partnership and took 2 more wickets in that same spell. They just couldn't end well as England's lower middle order somehow kept finding runs. Poonam Yadav was good with two wickets while Rajeshwari Gayakwad got one. Deepti Sharma went wicketless but bowled tidily at crucial stages, not to forget her run out of Katherine Brunt which surely saved 10-15 runs from this posted score. Shikha Pandey though was poor today and that contributed to the runs leaking at the fag end.

A good total from England on the board, all things considered. They started off rather solidly with the bat with their openers dealing with things well. They lost a few wickets in rather quick succession but then Sarah Taylor and Natalie Sciver pulled things back in their favour with a superb 83-run stand, with the latter going on to make a fifty. The partnership was broken and it looked like they would end up with an underwhelming score, but some handy knocks down the order from Katherine Brunt and Jenny Gunn ensured England have a fighting total on the board at the very least.

Flighted off spinner on off, Marsh walks down the track and hits it in the air towards mid off. Goes on one bounce to the fielder and they cross for a single. Terrific over by Deepti. England end on 228/7!
Jumps out of the crease and nearly yorks herself. Digs it out to mid off for a single.
This time it's swept straight to backward square leg for a quick single.
Tossed up ball on off, Gunn inside edges her attempted slog sweep. Pandey at backward square leg dives to stop the ball. A single taken. Good effort.
Shortish this time, around middle, Gunn walks down and slogs it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Flighted on leg, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Big responsibility, this. The teenager Deepti Sharma has been asked to bowl the final over of the innings.
Tossed up ball on middle, swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Flighted full ball on off, driven to covers for a brisk single. The fielder sent the throw but the bowler was standing wide of the stumps. Had to stretch to take the bails off and that gave time to Gunn to dive back in.
Walks down the track and the bowler shortens her length. Marsh adjusts well to play it towards long on for a run.
Shortish and on off, forced down to long on for one.
Another sweep shot on display, this time through backward square leg for a run.
Slower full ball around leg, Gunn inside edges her sweep to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Full in length and outside off, Marsh advances down the track and strokes it right through the gap at covers for a boundary. Useful runs for England.
Full toss again, Marsh slaps it straight to Deepti Sharma and crosses for a risky single. Slight fumble made it easy.
Free Hit coming up...
A high full toss and it's smashed down to deep mid-wicket for a couple. Called a no ball for being over waist height.

Too full in length outside off, Marsh shuffles across the stumps for the paddle shot but fails to middle it. The ball probably comes from the toe end of the bat and squirts to backward square leg for a run.
Play and a miss! Fuller length ball wide outside off, a swing and a miss by Laura Marsh.
Yorker on off, Jenny digs it out to covers and pinches a single.
FOUR! Shot! A touch short in length just outside off, Gunn stays back and guns her horizontal bat shot over mid-wicket for a powerful boundary. Meaty.
Loopy ball on middle, a cute little paddle shot down to fine leg for a couple of runs. 200 up for England and the crowd gets excited.
Steps down the track, goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Loopy and full on off, Laura lunges and nudges it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket for one.
Fires a full ball on leg, it's worked towards short fine leg for a single.
Walks down the track and brings her bat and pad together in defense. Maybe, some inside edge there.
Flatter and shorter outside off, a mistimed punch shot to covers.
Laura Marsh walks into the middle to bat. The target England should be looking at is 220 at least. Some brisk runs are needed now.

OUT! Bull's eye by Deepti Sharma! Shikha Pandey serves it full and outside off, Gunn pushes it to extra cover and they attempt for a hesitant single. Direct hit was needed and Sharma comes up with that at the striker's end. Brunt is not even in the picture. Massive breakthrough.
Fuller and wider outside off, hit back to the bowler who did well to stop it.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and swings her bat. Fails to middle it and under edges it towards mid on for a single.
Fullish outside off, bunted to mid off for a quick single.
Full toss outside off, Brunt walks down the track and drills it through cover-point for one.
Too full in length outside off, Gunn outside edges her drive down to third man for a single.
Shikha Pandey comes back into the attack.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batters have run through for a single.
Flighted outside off, slog swept over mid-wicket for a single.

Short and outside off, Gunn rocks back and punches it past extra cover. The mid off fielder cuts it off and they cross. The throw comes towards the bowler who tries to collect it and is in the way of Jenny. Collision happens, Poonam takes a tumble and Gunn quickly apologizes.

Floated and outside off, Katherine gets across the stumps, goes down on one knee and sweeps it towards square leg for a run. Kaur has a weak shy at the non-striker's end. Clearly not comfortable with her shoulders.
Flatter and on off, skidding in this time, Brunt gets back and punches it to covers.
Nicely tossed up delivery outside off, a leg spinner, Brunt dances down to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to mid off.
Poonam Yadav to bowl out.
Fullish and on off, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Mithali Raj has a chat with her bowler. Maybe, reminding her about the field set.
FOUR! Quality shot! Floated full ball outside off, Brunt presses forward and drives it crisply through extra cover for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, Gunn swings her bat and deliberately keeps it down. Hits it past short mid-wicket and takes a single.
Long hop outside off, Brunt gets back and pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on a driving length, close to off, swept away through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy full toss around off, knocked to long off past the diving bowler for a single.
Deepti Sharma to bowl again.
Jumps out of the crease and works it to mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! Tossed up ball on middle, nudged to mid-wicket and they crossed. The bowler ran across to her right, picked up the ball and scored a direct hit at the bowler's end as Brunt dived in. There wasn't anyone backing and they picked up an overthrow too. Now, the umpire checked upstairs but Brunt was safely in.
A run out appeal is referred upstairs as there's a direct hit at the bowler's end against Brunt.
Flatter and outside off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Goes down on one knee and paddles it towards fine leg. A couple taken.
Tossed up ball outside off, defended back.

Confusion over a run, no harm done eventually. Loopy ball on middle and off, Brunt helps it to mid-wicket and looks for a run. The fielder quickly gets to the ball and hence she sends her partner back. She dives in to make it safely. The throw wasn't accurate.
What happened there? A slow loopy ball outside off, spinning away and staying low, Gunn leaves it.

Aerial...safe! Flatter and shorter delivery on off, Brunt gets across the stumps, goes deep inside the crease and tries to whip on the leg side. It gathers the top edge, balloons in the air and Mandhana runs across to her left from backward square leg. She attempts to take the catch with a dive but misses as the ball falls wide. A single taken.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to the off side.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it in front of square leg. They cross for a hesitant second run as the throw from the deep was extremely bad.
Wrong 'un outside off, on the shorter side, Katherine punches from the back foot to covers.
Extra flight, well over the eye level of the batter, full and on off, Brunt defends it safely.
Shortish and outside off, Gunn goes back and punches it to covers.
Dances down the track to a full ball and forces it past the bowler to long off for a single.
Uses her feet and helps it down to long on for one.
Shortish and on middle, Brunt kneels and pulls it behind square leg for a run.
Skips down the track to a full ball and pushes it back.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back off the front foot.
Fullish on off, Brunt plays it off the inside portion of the bat on the leg side for a single. 10-3-23-3, excellent figures Jhulan! Also, 13/1 in the Batting Powerplay.
Pitches it full and outside off, Gunn goes hard at it and sends it down to long on for one. Gets off the mark after 12 deliveries.
Angles in a full ball on off, extra bounce, Gunn gets behind the line and defends it from the upper half of the bat.
Beaten! Superb delivery, on a length outside off, holding its line, Gunn has a tame push inside the line and misses.
Good length ball on off, Brunt goes on the back foot and punches it in the gap at cover-point for a single.
Fullish and on off, Brunt is forward as she opens the face of the bat to push it towards backward point.
Goes on the back foot to a flatter ball on off and punches it to covers. Tidy over, good going for India in the Batting Powerplay.
Floated full ball outside off, spinning away, a loose drive attempted by Jenny and it goes off the outside edge to backward point.
Another arm ball, landing on off and skidding in, Gunn goes back and punches it down. The short mid-wicket fielder does well to make a good stop.
An arm ball on off, Gunn is on the front foot as he pushes it away on the off side.
Floated full ball on off, defended firmly off the front foot to the off side.
Flighted and on off, Brunt gets back and turns it through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad returns to bowl.
Around off on a length, defended again to covers. A wicket maiden for Jhulan!
Gunn has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Jhulan Goswami runs in to bowl but the umpire stops her midway and signals a dead ball. Maybe there was some movement in the field which is why the bowler was stopped in between. There's now a change in field too, Punam Raut has been moved to long on.
Lands it on a fuller length around off, a solid front foot defense offered by Gunn.
Angles in a full ball on off, Gunn plays across the line but finds mid on.
Fullish and on off, dug out back to the bowler.
Jenny Gunn is next in to bat. And as she walks out, it's started to rain again, just a drizzle for now.

OUT! That's plumb! Jhulan has turned it around for India. Delivers a fuller length ball around off, Sciver takes a step down the track, gets across and tries to flick on the leg side. Misses and is thudded on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Natalie Sciver takes the referral but the Ball Tracking confirms that she is hit in line and the ball is going on to hit the middle stump. This is a big setback for England as the set batter is gone.
This could be the turning point in how this game goes. Jhulan Goswami has caught Natalie Sciver leg before. This looks out to the naked eye. Going to be real close...
FOUR! England will hope that this boundary will break the shackles. A very full ball on middle, Brunt runs down the track and hammers it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Walks forward and across to a length ball and nudges it down to mid on. A quick single taken, plan was for the second but the fielder came in quickly from the deep.
Good length delivery outside off, Sciver plays it down with an angled bat to point.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Fuller and outside off, driven straight to covers.
9th ODI fifty for Natalie Sciver!

Fifty! A loosener, full toss on off, Sciver walks down the track and forces it to long on for a single. What a knock this has been from her. Big stage, big pressure and she's delivering again with the bat. Huge round of applause from the knowledgeable Lord's crowd. Her job is not done though.
Shikha Pandey is back on.
Fuller and on middle, flicked in front of square leg but straight to Mithali Raj. Dot ball to end the over, a good one by Jhulan.
A deep mid-wicket in place now...
An off pace delivery, full and around off, Katherine jumps out of the crease and pushes it back.
Defended off the front foot by Brunt presenting the full face of the bat.
This time Sciver taps a length ball down to backward point and pinches a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sciver pushes inside the line in an attempt to play it down to third man but misses.
Short in length and outside off, cut behind point for a single.
Batting Powerplay signalled. It will be from the 36th over till the 40th over.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Played to the point region by Sciver. No run.

Chance for a run out, missed! Oh dear! Tossed up ball on off, Sciver tries to flick on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. It runs towards short third man off the leading edge and they cross for a single. Sciver wants the second run and keeps on running. Her partner is late though in taking off. Raut has reached the ball and fires in the throw at the keeper's end. Sushma Verma collects the ball and tries to deflect it onto the stumps. Misses and Natalie makes it safely. Could have gone to the other end. India have missed a big opportunity.
Delivers a wrong 'un from the back of the hand this time, around off and it's punched through covers for one.
Short ball on middle and leg, it's pulled firmly down to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flighted off spinner on off, Sciver defends it back off the front foot.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes back for another spell.
Sciver uses her feet to reach the pitch of the delivery and eases it to long on for one.
Big cheer from the capacity Lord's crowd as England reach 150! A quiet nudge on the leg side for a single by Brunt.
Full toss this time, Brunt comes down the track and hits it on one bounce to mid on.

Teasingly looped again, full and on off, Brunt helps it behind square leg and crosses for a sharp single. The fielder misses her shy at the striker's end and Veda backing up fumbles. Another run taken.
Slower fuller ball on off, 38 mph, Brunt gets forward and across in defense.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.

No hat-trick for Jhulan as Katherine Brunt is rock solid in defense. Unlucky, but she's done the job for her side nonetheless. Two runs and as many wickets in this over. The Indians are right back in this game.
Katherine Brunt to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TWO IN TWO FOR JHULAN! Experience coming to the fore and delivering, amazing stuff. Fired in full on leg, angling down a touch. Fran Wilson looks to flick but misses and is caught low on the pads. Loud appeal and this time the umpire raises his finger without much hesitation. No review taken this time either, smart call. Would have clipped leg stump at most and the umpire's call would have stayed. Golden duck for Wilson.
Drinks break. India will be relieved at the moment after breaking the partnership between Taylor and Sciver. Fran Wilson has joined Natalie Sciver in the middle.

OUT! SHE'S GONE! Jhulan Goswami was brought back in to take a wicket, this pair needed to be separated and she's done just that. Partnership of 83 comes to an end. Not a wicket-taking delivery in any sense, as Goswami fires it down leg. Sarah Taylor looks to flick and seems to have gotten something on it as the keeper shouts loudly. The umpire takes a lot of time, thinks hard and raises his finger eventually. Taylor starts walking and doesn't take the review, which surely means there was some bat involved. Just the wicket India wanted, they can make further inroads from here.
Flicks the ball off her pads. Won't get any run for it though.
Touch fuller and swinging back in, Taylor whips it across the line and places it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Short of a good length around off, jabbed from the crease towards short mid-wicket.
Takes it on the full by coming out of her crease and knocks it to long on for a run.
Just back of a driving length, Natalie with a neat little shimmy comes down the wicket and pushes it long on. One run added to the scoreboard.
Drops this short in length, outside off, cut away to the covers for no run.
Leans half-forward as it's fullish in length, Sarah with a sweet drive to long on for a single.
Dances down the track to this flighted delivery and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Extremely loopy well outside off, Sciver drags it through mid-wicket for a single.
Poonam Yadav is back on.
Shaping back in on the stumps, flicked through to deep mid-wicket. A run to end the over.

IN THE AIR... BUT NO CATCH! It's gone just over Jhulan Goswami. Sciver looks to work it across the line but closes the face too early. It bobbles off the leading edge and lobs just past the bowler who was a bit lazy in anticipating it. Close call.
Shaping back in on leg, clipped through backward square leg for one.
Stays back to this length ball, not much foot movement this time but it isn't needed. Just eases it through extra cover for a run.
Three wides! Down the leg side, Sciver looks to flick but misses and so does the keeper. Allows the batters to take two. Get three in total.
Length delivery around off, seaming away a shade, Sarah with a gentle push through the covers for a single.
Good length ball on off, pushed back down the track.
India in need of wickets and skipper Mithali Raj has gone for her most experienced bowler. Jhulan Goswami is brought back into the attack.
Easily done. Drives it back down to long off and keeps strike.
Sarah Taylor dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Shuffles across, skips down and with a nice straight bat, drives it back down the ground for a run.
Deepti provides some good air as she tosses it up around off, Sciver drives it straight back to her.
Deft from Natalie. She waits for it, plays it very late as she cuts it towards third man. Gets a couple of runs for doing so.
Moves across to this off spinner, picks it up from outside off and tucks it to deep square leg. One run taken.
Leg stump line again, flicked away on the on side again. Runs off every delivery. Good one for England, 10 have come from it.
Loopy full toss, swept away to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! There's that sweep shot, she's nailed another one to perfection. The line is outside leg and it's swept across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Full and straight, driven to long on. One more run taken.
Drifting down leg, poor line and it enables Taylor to tickle it fine. Two run taken as the fielder chases it down.

Around the wicket again, floats it up on leg. Sciver off her back foot looks to flick but it goes off her pads on the on side. Verma runs to the ball and mimes a throw at the bowler's end, as Natalie had already made it in by then. Leg bye taken.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes back into the attack.
The batter flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Works it with the spin and places it through mid-wicket. Single.
Tad short again but it keeps a little low. Taylor is back to pull but is hit on the pads. Probably going down leg, maybe some bottom edge on it too.
Short in length, which allows Natalie Sciver time to camp back and pull it to deep square leg. One run taken.
Takes a step out, plays with the spin and drives it back to the bowler.
Turning in on middle and leg, Taylor flicks it off her pads as she works it behind square leg for one run.
Deepti Sharma to have another go with her off spinners.
50-run stand between Taylor and Sciver.
FOUR! Ends the over with a boundary, this is good positive batting from Nat Sciver. She crisply drives this full delivery past mid off and sends it away.
Taylor moves across seeing this full ball outside off, positions herself to play the paddle and places it to fine leg for a run.
Angling down leg a touch, helped to fine leg for one.
Length delivery skidding off the surface, hit towards mid on with a straight blade.
Gentle delivery on a bit of a fuller length, hint of inswing, driven to mid off by Natalie.
Angling back in from around off, Sarah uses the angle and works it down to fine leg. Jogs across and completes the run.

Carrying on in spite of the rains. The floodlights are switched on. Maybe, the umpires feel it's just a passing shower. Meanwhile, a bowling change from India. Shikha Pandey is brought back into the attack...
Takes a step out yet again, gets close to the pitch and works it away against the spin. Through mid-wicket and a single is taken.
Punched away off the back foot. No run taken.
Once again the rain is coming down heavily.
Full toss, Taylor is unable to put it away for a boundary. She whips it through to deep mid-wicket for a double.
Nice flight from Yadav, Sciver gets to the pitch and works it away on the leg side. One run added to the total.
Quicker one on the stumps, Sciver goes back and shapes for the cut but it takes the top half of the bat and goes away on the off side.
Googly around off, on a flatter trajectory, kept out off the back foot.
The groundsmen were ready to charge in with the covers but the rain seems to have eased out a bit. The umpire is keeping the players on the field for now. Poonam Yadav to continue...
Short and flat on leg, Natalie sits down a bit and pulls it away on the leg side for a single.
Sarah Taylor flicks it away with a wristy shot. A single is taken.
It's coming down hard now. The groundsmen are ready with the hover cover. The umpires probably waiting for this over to get completed.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Kaur bowls it across around off, Sarah Taylor tries playing the reverse paddle but fails to connect.
Not much spin on this occasion, Sciver works it down the leg side for a run.
FOUR! The rain is probably making the ball skid more. Credit to Natalie Sciver though, she plays the sweep shot really well. Brooms this away through backward square leg for a boundary.
Floats it up on the pads, clipped through to deep mid-wicket for a single.

This is leg spinner from Poonam but it doesn't turn. Goes straight and keeps low too as it skids off the deck. Natalie Sciver does well as she rocks back and punches it off the bottom part of the bat towards cover.
Full in length, worked away through mid-wicket again for one run.
Brings her wrists into play and whips it through mid-wicket. Big gap out there, so the two batters run hard to come back for the second. Complete it with ease too.
A bit quicker through the air, darted on middle, drilled back straight to mid on yet again.
It's turning gloomy out there and the rain is picking up its intensity. Movement near the boundary line from the groundsmen. Keep your fingers crossed, folks.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven hard but it's straight to mid on.
Nice shape on this one, on off, Taylor is forward in defense.
Change of ends for Poonam Yadav.
Leans ahead to this full delivery and drives it through mid on to keep strike.
Tad short again, on middle and leg, pulled away through mid-wicket for a single.
Some rain in the air.
Sciver waits for the ball to come to her and slaps it back down the track.
Very, very slow on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Bit short in length once more, Sciver punches it towards Mithali Raj at short mid-wicket.
Starts from around the wicket and bowls it short on the hips, Taylor nudges it behind square leg and takes one.
Star player, Harmanpreet Kaur to bowl.
Hangs deep inside her crease and punches it to covers for nothing.
Loopy and full on middle, driven towards mid on.
One more short ball, Taylor pulls it through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Well done, Sarah. That kept very low. Pitched short, came to her ankle height but she did well to bring her blade down in time. Could have been easily bowled.
Flat, short and spinning in slightly from around off, punched off the back foot down to long on for a run.
Low dipping full toss on middle and leg, Sarah Taylor sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Deepti Sharma comes back on.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Natalie. Dot ball to end the over.
Rotating the strike well here, another run. Milked to long on with ease.
Bit fullish in length, Natalie skips down the track and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Wrists this away through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket area to rotate strike.
Another driven down the ground but this time it's towards long off. One more taken.
Drifting in on middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.

Not out! Taylor works it off her pads and tucks it towards backward square leg. Both batters take off and Poonam Yadav is quick to get to the ball. Has a shy at the keeper's end and scores a direct hit. It goes upstairs and replays show Natalie Sciver has just made it in. Close one, that.
Direct hit by Poonam Raut at the striker's end. Is Sciver in danger?

Full ball on middle and leg, driven sweetly towards wide long on. Harmanpreet Kaur out in the deep moves to her right and cuts it off. Seems to be still struggling with her shoulder somewhat. Is hesitant to throw the ball at first. Two taken.
Fuller and slowish in pace, forces Sciver to flick early. However, she closes the face of the bat early and it goes off the leading edge through backward point for a run.
Nicely done. Taylor leans ahead and works it 'round the corner to get one.
Flights it just back of a driving length on leg, allows Sciver to kneel down and sweep it away to deep backward square leg for one.
Quite full and attacking the stumps, tight defensive shot from Natalie.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes back into the attack.
Another risky run, but this time it's completed with more ease. Natalie Sciver drives it just wide of mid off and scurries across.
Wide outside off, cut away for nothing.
This one keeps very low as it's pitched outside off, Natalie goes back and does well to adjust and bring down her bat in time to keep it out.
Charges down the wicket one more, another block.
Uses her feet to get to the pitch of the ball and meets the ball with her bat.
FOUR! Juicy full toss on middle and leg, Sciver unlike Tammy Beaumont dispatches this with ease. Plays it across the line through mid-wicket and keeps it along the carpet throughout. Boundary!

Chance of a run out! Sciver drives it to mid off and takes on Gayakwad positioned there. She fires it at the bowler's end where Deepti Sharma can't collect it. Natalie dives in however and eats a lot of dust in the process. Makes it in at the end and that's all that matters. Single completed.
Pushed away to the covers for nothing.
Short and wide, Natalie cuts it square on the off side.

FOUR! That's a good shot, very good shot. Sciver gives the charge to this tossed up delivery and launches it back over the bowler's head. No chance for anybody to stop it as it goes across the fence for a boundary.
Full on off, driven back down the track towards the bowler.
Provides plenty of air on this occasion and bowls it wide outside off, on a fuller length, Sciver reaches out to it and pushes it to point.
A lot of flight on this occasion, from deep inside her crease it's flicked away on the leg side.
Punched off the back foot by the batter. They pick up a single.
Hangs back to this flat ball and keeps it out off the back foot.
Prods forward to this slower ball and defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up but around leg this time, Sciver looks to sweep but is hit on the pads. Was going down leg.
Natalie Sciver is in next with England in trouble.

OUT! SUCCESSFUL REVIEW FROM INDIA! This is excellent, big blow for England as their skipper departs. Poonam Yadav floats it up just on off and it doesn't spin much, rather keeps going on with the angle after landing. Heather Knight kneels down to sweep, misses and is hit on the front pad. Loud appeal goes up but the umpire remains unmoved. India review immediately and it goes upstairs. Impact is probably the only thing that could save her here and replays show that it's hit in line. Heather Knight has to depart. The Indians march on. Sushma Verma, the keeper, played a big role there in convincing Mithali Raj to go for the DRS. Well done. India on top.
Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire remains unmoved and Poonam Yadav and Sushma Verma convince their skipper to take the referral. Seems the impact is outside off. Let's see...

Drinks are on the field! England started off well scoring 42 in the first 8 overs, but then managed only 21 in the next 8 for the loss of 2 wickets. India have slowly come back into this game well. Can they pile on further pressure from this point on?
Extra slower through the air, outside off, Taylor prods forward to defend but it finds the bottom half of the bat and rolls behind. The first slip fielder dives to make the stop.
Too full in length again, Heather plays it down to long on for one.
Mid on drops back.
Very full and on off, hit firmly across the line but finds mid on.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it safely.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Floated ball on off, forced down to long on for one.
Deepti Sharma returns.
Flighted on off, Knight defends it off her front foot. Successful over, 2 runs and a wicket off it!
Knight has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another full toss, this time it has been pushed down to long on for one.
Skipper Heather Knight walks in next.

OUT! Softest of dismissals! And it's a big wicket, the in-form batter for England in this tournament is out of here. Poonam Yadav gets lucky with this wicket though. A leg spinner is often a lucky breed. We have seen umpteenth time that they have got wickets of absolutely poor deliveries. A rank full toss on middle, Beaumont skips down the track, fails to resist the temptation and tries to smack this one into orbit. However, she fails to get any timing or power behind it. Ends up ballooning it in the air and Jhulan Goswami at deep mid-wicket takes the simplest of catches. India taking upper hand in this game.
Extra slow through the air, full and on middle, Sarah forces it down to long on for a single.

Shout for a catch! Wonderful delivery, a generously tossed up leg spinner outside off, slow spin away from the batter, Taylor tries to play late but misses. Verma catches the ball, appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Poonam Yadav, the leggie, is introduced into the attack.
Tossed up ball on middle, Tammy comes down the track and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for England. Short this time by the bowler, outside off, Beaumont rocks back and hammers it through cover-point for a boundary.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
Floated one on off, driven back to the bowler.

Fancy footwork by Sarah Taylor. She dances down the track to a full ball and lofts it over the bowler's head. Kaur from mid on gives the chase and pulls it back just before the fence. She parries it to Mandhana running in from mid off who throws it back in play. A couple taken.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Uses her feet to get to the pitch of the ball and pushes it down on one bounce to mid on.
Jhulan Goswami is back on the field.
Flighted and very full outside off, Beaumont drives but without much timing.
A handy footwork this time by Sarah, jumps out of the crease to take it on the full and bunts it down to long on for one.
A little short and outside off, slower in pace again, Sarah mistimes her punch to covers.
Full floated on off, flicked with the turn but straight to mid-wicket.
Wide! Goes slower through the air again but this one is too wide outside off. Taylor allows it through.
Loopy delivery outside off, a touch on the shorter side, Taylor goes back to punch but mistimes it completely.
Arm ball on off, Sarah reads it late but does well eventually to work it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, pushed down to mid on.
Tossed up ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
Gets back and tucks it to fine leg for a couple of runs. Sarah is off the mark!
Floated and on off, Taylor gets forward and across in defense.
Sarah Taylor arrives at number 3.

OUT! Bowled round her legs! Gayakwad, you beauty. She once again pitches a full ball in the zone just outside leg and gets it to spin towards the stumps. Winfield kneels down for the sweep shot but misses and finds her stumps disturbed. What a comeback from Rajeshwari, went for 12 runs in her first over, followed it up with a maiden and now the first breakthrough.
Wide! Tossed up ball wide outside leg, Beaumont fails to sweep.

Appeal for an lbw! Floated off spinner landing on middle, turning down, Winfield tries to sweep but misses. It goes off her pads, brushes the keeper's pads and gets deflected towards point. A leg bye taken. Maybe missing leg, that's why the umpire didn't entertain the appeal.
Winfield has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller and on middle, flicked with the spin again, this time past short fine leg and the fielder behind in the deep stopped it. A couple taken.
Turning down the leg side, Winfield flicks off the pads but finds short fine leg.
Flatter this time, spinning in and staying low too, Lauren does well to keep it out towards mid-wicket.
A nicely tossed up delivery, an off spinner, Winfield gets forward and pushes it with the spin to mid on.
19-year old Deepti Sharma is brought into the bowling attack. Can she be the one to break this opening stand? Has a slip in place.
Maiden! Excellent over by Gayakwad. Slants one in on off, Beaumont gets back in defense.
Jumps out of the crease and brings her pad and bat together in defense. Maybe, some inside edge and it pops out but dies down safely on the off side.
Another quicker one, around off, Beaumont gets back and punches it towards point.
Fires one in, around off, Tammy moves back and pushes it to the leg side.
Flighted and full around off, driven off the front foot to covers.

Dropped by the keeper! Tossed up ball outside off, Beaumont gets forward to push inside the line but gets a thick outside edge behind. Sushma Verma fails to react quickly and a chance goes down begging.
Jhulan Goswami is seen going off the field. Maybe her first spell is over.
Fullish and on off, defended off the front foot. End of another quiet over by Jhulan.
Fuller on off, driven back past the bowler and the mid on fielder ran across to her left to make a good stop. Nicely anticipated.
Winfield has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Not out! A good use of the review by England. It's a fair straightforward delivery, full and around middle, Winfield fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal, it looks quite close and up goes the finger. Winfield has a chat with Tammy and then signals for the DRS. The Ball Tracker shows it to be missing leg. Lauren survives, all thanks to the DRS.
Lauren Winfield has been caught leg before low on the pads. To the naked eye, it looks it just might go down leg. We'll have to wait and see what happens here...
Walks forward to a full ball on middle and leg, fails to flick and it goes off her pads to the leg side. They appeal as the batters cross. Given as a leg bye. Missing leg, probably.
Full and around off, angling in, Beaumont defends it off her front foot.
FOUR! Excellent stuff from Winfield. Kneels forward and across to a full ball again and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary. 12 from the first over of spin.
Slower full ball on off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Great shot in the end. Flighted and full around off, Winfield gets down forward and across and unveils a lovely sweep shot. Although risky as it beats the leg stump and goes right through the legs of the keeper.
Tossed up and outside off, pushed off the front foot to point.
Drifting into the batter from around off, Winfield hits it back from the inner half of the bat.
FOUR! Placement of the highest order! A well tossed up ball on off, but too full in length, Winfield gets half forward and drills it through covers for a boundary.
First bowling change for India. Rajeshwari Gayakwad is into the attack now. Spin early on for the Women in Blue.
Length delivery on off, Tammy remains back in defense. Maiden by Goswami!
Just a little bit of short on off, Beaumont goes for the pull shot but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Good lines by Jhulan. Good length ball on off, not offering any room, Beaumont is forced to defend from the back foot.
On a length around off, shaping back in, Beaumont does well to keep it out safely on the off side.
Too full in length on off, once again Beaumont gives the charge and digs it out past the bowler to mid off.
Lands it on a length outside off, Beaumont gets back and punches it off the back foot to cover-point.
Good length ball angling into the batsman around off, Lauren gets behind the line and blocks. 9 from the over!
Clever change in pace, stopping onto the batter around middle, Winfield is early into the shot and plays it in the air. Falls safely near short mid-wicket.
A touch short and outside off, Beaumont walks forward and across to run it down to third man for a single. Looking very positive.
Too full and outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
FOUR! Excellent by Beaumont. Not hitting the ball hard, just placing it with pure timing. A full length ball outside off has been creamed by Tammy through extra cover. Runs coming now for England.

FOUR! Shot! A shade overpitched and outside off, Beaumont gets forward with a high backlift and strokes it elegantly past the diving cover-point fielder for a boundary. Deepti Sharma could have done better there. 400 runs in the tournament for Tammy!
Drifting onto the pads again, once again it's been played through square leg. A couple taken. Good start this for England!
Fuller in length on middle, worked behind square leg for a single.
Edged but safe! Good length ball outside off, slower in pace, Beaumont pushes inside the line, although with soft hands and edges it behind. Doesn't carry to first slip.
Width on offer outside off, Winfield bottom edges her attempted square cut and it goes past first slip. They cross for a single as Smriti Mandhana in the deep was very swift in her job.
Identical to the last delivery, it's driven straight back and the bowler makes the stop. The non-striker who was backing up immediately dives back in.
Fuller and around off, angling in, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Tammy rocks back to play the square cut but is beaten by the extra bounce. Much better over this time by Pandey.
Wide! Flirts with the tramline but this time it's wide of it this time. The batter leaves it and the umpire stretches his arms.
Too wide outside off, Beaumont feels no need to play at it.
Uses her feet to smother the swing and pushes a full ball back to the bowler. Pandey without collecting the ball threatens to throw it at the batter.

On a length and outside off, Winfield gets back and tries to steer it through the gap between cover-point and point. But Deepti Sharma dives inside the ring to stop the ball. Cannot prevent the single though.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, going straight on, Lauren allows it through to the keeper.
Full in length and outside off, Winfield who is standing quite across the stumps in her stance just pushes it to covers.
Goes full this time, Goswami. Lands it around off and Beaumont is rock solid in her front foot defense.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished. Short and wide outside off, Beaumont exercises her arms and slaps it through cover-point. Third man is standing square but still fails to cut it off.
Alters her length to go full and outside off, Tammy drives it from the front foot to covers.
Back of a length ball on off, Beaumont goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Fullish and outside off, Tammy drives it firmly to mid off and screams wait on. Her partner who was outside the crease returns. That was hit too well but straight to the fielder.
Pitches it full and around off, angling in, Beaumont gets forward and defends it near her front pad.

FOUR! Sloppy by Mandhana. Early nerves probably. Winfield receives an overpitched delivery in her half and unfurls a superb on drive. Mandhana inside the ring dives over the ball and lets it through to the fence. 10 runs from the over, an expensive one from Shikha!
Too full in length outside off, Tammy strides forward, reaches out for it and drives it down to third man for a single. The third man fielder is placed quite square, maybe as a part of strategy.
FOUR! Shikha struggles with her line this time, bowls it full and on middle, Beaumont, the batter in form for England, flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Beaumont stands outside the crease to counter the big swing and takes a stride forward to push the full ball on the off side.
Big inswinger again but the line is too straight. Winfield works it off her pads to fine leg for a single.
Terrific beginning. Big swing first up. An inswinging one, dipping in and landing close to the blockhole, Winfield digs it out off the inside half of the bat and gets hit on the pads.
Shikha Pandey will bowl from the other end. She too has a slip in place.

First run on the board! Although it wasn't a convincing shot. Jhulan serves it on a fuller length on off, a hint of away movement as the batter goes to play. It takes the outer half of the bat and rolls past backward point for a single. England are away!
This one is angled into the batsman, on a good length, Winfield is behind the line in defense.
There is forecast for rain today but right now, the sun is out and shining beautifully down at Lord's. This is encouraging to see.
Keeps her length ball on off again, Winfield goes on the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Drops it on a length and just outside off, this time Lauren goes on the back foot in defense.
Delivers it on a fuller length around off, Winfield is on the front foot in defense.
Starts with a gentle delivery, on a length and outside off, low bounce, Winfield makes an easy leave.

Huge cheer for the English openers, Lauren Winfield and Tammy Beaumont. We are seconds away from the first ball of the final. Jhulan Goswami to begin proceedings with the ball. Winfield to take first strike. A lone slip in place. Let's play...
All done. The Indian girls are in a huddle near the boundary line. Smiling faces all around. It's a massive stage and they would like to come out with flying colours. Now, they are taking the field.
Big moment for the ladies as they take the field at Lord's. It's a capacity crowd in attendance and the atmosphere out there is electric. Time for the national anthems.

Pitch for the final - Ian Bishop says this pitch was used way back in May. Is surprised the wicket is dry despite the rain yesterday. States there's some good grass and a nice mat on it and the Indian pacers can bowl well first up. Reckons the wicket could get a little bit drier and scuffed up later in the game, so might be something there for the spinners.
India - Smriti Mandhana, Punam Raut, Mithali Raj(c), Harmanpreet Kaur, Deepti Sharma, Veda Krishnamurthy, Sushma Verma(wk), Jhulan Goswami, Shikha Pandey, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Poonam Yadav.
England - Lauren Winfield, Tammy Beaumont, Sarah Taylor(wk), Heather Knight(c), Natalie Sciver, Fran Wilson, Katherine Brunt, Jenny Gunn, Laura Marsh, Anya Shrubsole, Alex Hartley.

Mithali Raj says that they would have batted but they are prepared for both. Feels her seamers will use these conditions to their advantage and also hopes that the spinners come into play. Adds that her girls are fearless and they are very confident of their game. Informs that they too are going unchanged.

Heather Knight says they will bat first. Mentions having runs on the board is important in a final. Adds there's a little bit of grass on the wicket and the ball should come on to the bat nicely. States there's a lovely crowd today, they've been fantastic throughout and hope it's the same. When asked about the weather, she hopes they can get a full game today. Ends saying there are no changes in the team for this big game.
Up goes the coin for the final time in this tournament. Mithali Raj calls it incorrectly and ENGLAND ELECT TO BAT!

The two teams met earlier in the tournament and the Indians prevailed comfortably in that encounter. Things have changed since then though, with England winning seven games in a row after that. Nevertheless, they will be aware of their nemesis. India did have a couple of blips in the tournament before thumping wins against New Zealand in a must-win game before the encore against Australia in the semi-final. Two rip-rocking sides with very little to separate them. Maybe, just maybe, England have a slight advantage being the hosts but it all boils down who holds their nerves better. Toss is coming shortly!

Hello folks, a warm welcome to our coverage of the Women's World Cup final at the iconic Lord's stadium in England. The tournament hosts are in the park and will be facing an enigmatic Indian side in what promises to be a mouth-watering contest. Remember, India have never won the title, having reached the final just once in 2005 when they lost to Australia. On the other hand, England have won the trophy thrice, having won both the tournaments they have hosted. Can they make it a treble at home? India have only made a single World Cup final at Lord's when their men's team told an evergreen underdog story to the world by winning the trophy. Can the Women's repeat the tale a generation later?
